name: Accedere Ltd.
summary: Accedere Ltd. provides specialized consulting services focused on cybersecurity and privacy assurance. The company's core expertise lies in cloud-based solutions, encompassing governance risk management and compliance frameworks. Its comprehensive service offerings include System and Organization Controls (SOC) reporting for cloud environments, blockchain technology audits, cloud security assessments, and evaluations of critical infrastructure. Accedere Ltd. was established on July 14, 1983, and operates from its headquarters in Mumbai, India.
